items.html: *Now we shall explain how during the death of these kings, their vessels descended to the world of Beria, which is not so in the four posterior of AVI. Now we have explained the division that was between AVI and the seven kings, which are ZON. We have said that the seven kings that are ZON, actually died descended to the world of Beria, and their vessels and the posterior of AVI were canceled and did not die. Instead, they descended below in the world of Atzilut itself. We have explained the reason for it there, and said that it became the reason that the seven kings did not receive the lights of AHP of AK, but only from its Guf onward.
